from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=programs/'task-9baeb526.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    items = []
    for row in grid:
        i = 0
        while i < len(row):
            if row[i] == background:
                i += 1
                continue
            color = row[i]
            items.append(color)
            while i < len(row) and row[i] == color:
                i += 1
    items.sort(reverse=True)
    items = (items + [0] * 6)[:6]
    return [items[:3], items[3:]]
'''
path.write_text(source)

spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
